title: Is the mutex free?
summary: pthread_mutex_trylock does not wait: it returns EBUSY when the mutex is taken.
hints: `pthread_mutex_trylock` returns 0 when it got the mutex, and `EBUSY` (from `<errno.h>`) when somebody holds it.
Order: main locks, creates the thread, joins it, only then unlocks. After that, a `trylock` in main must succeed (and be unlocked again).
